title: 最小 XOR
summary: 构造正整数 x，使其一比特数量等于 num2，且 x 与 num1 的异或值最小。
insight: 优先复用 num1 中权重最高的一位以避免昂贵异或差；数量仍不足时，从低位起设置 num1 原本为零的位。
pitfalls: 一比特总数必须完全相等
补位应从最低空位开始

solutions.title: 保留高位一再补低位零
solutions.idea: 按每位对异或值贡献的权重贪心。
steps: bit 从30到0，若 num1 该位为一且 need>0则设置并 need--
bit 从0到30，若 answer 该位未设且 need>0则设置

code.java: class Solution { public int minimizeXor(int num1,int num2){int need=Integer.bitCount(num2),answer=0;for(int bit=30;bit>=0&&need>0;bit--)if((num1&(1<<bit))!=0){answer|=1<<bit;need--;}for(int bit=0;bit<=30&&need>0;bit++)if((answer&(1<<bit))==0){answer|=1<<bit;need--;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minimizeXor(num1:Int,num2:Int):Int{var need=Integer.bitCount(num2);var answer=0;for(bit in 30 downTo 0)if(need>0&&num1 and (1 shl bit)!=0){answer=answer or (1 shl bit);need--};for(bit in 0..30)if(need>0&&answer and (1 shl bit)==0){answer=answer or (1 shl bit);need--};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int minimizeXor(int num1,int num2){int need=__builtin_popcount(num2),answer=0;for(int bit=30;bit>=0&&need;--bit)if(num1&(1<<bit)){answer|=1<<bit;--need;}for(int bit=0;bit<=30&&need;++bit)if(!(answer&(1<<bit))){answer|=1<<bit;--need;}return answer;} };
